title: NON-WEAPON PROFICIENCIES - the peaceful-arts doctrine with the base-chance rules, the optional bonuses, the success-and-failure doctrine and the contests
audit_comment: OA round thirty-nine (capture pp. 101-103): the non-weapon proficiencies prose - the category and learning doctrine, the base-chance and slot-improvement rules with the Akimori example, the optional peaceful bonuses, the success-and-failure doctrine and the contests

banner.title: NON-WEAPON PROFICIENCIES, printed capture pp. 101-103 - the OA non-weapon proficiencies round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture (the settling authority), with the compressed-print capture giving a second independent read of the section - the prose cross-checked doctrine by doctrine between the two passes (the categories, the learning requirements and the base-chance rules opening on capture p. 101 of the print pass, the slot-improvement floor, the magical-item rule, the Akimori example, the optional bonuses and the success-and-failure doctrine printing on p. 102, the contests closing on p. 103; compressed p. 53 carries the full pass). Every doctrine agrees between the passes save one OCR artifact class: the compressed pass renders the slot bonus and the optional bonuses as minus signs (adds - 1 to the die roll, a bonus of - 1, - 2, he is now - 3 on the die roll) where the print pass prints the pluses (+1 per slot, +1 and +2 bonuses, +1 and +3 on the die roll) - the Akimori arithmetic (17 to 16 to 14, the chance FALLS as the bonus rises) would read nonsense with genuine minuses on the die-roll modifiers, so the print signs settle genuine pluses per the R650 plus-as-minus artifact precedent, and the pins carry the print reading. The numbers pin as consts - the four categories, the second-level improvement opening, the +1 slot bonus, the never-below-3 floor, the Akimori example pair (base 17, chances 16 and 14 at third and fourth), the optional +1/+2 bonuses and the informal/formal contest experience at 50 and 100 times the host's level; the categorical rules pin as bools - the only-barbarians rule, the category learning environments, the no-study-times doctrine, the tools-and-guidance requirement, the base-like-to-hit doctrine, the never-improves rule, the magical-only-if-known rule, the strictly-optional rule, the success-and-failure doctrines and the contest rules (formal vs impromptu, the elimination resolution, the inauspicious all-fail rule). Names and text ride comments - Torimatsu Akimori, the calligraphy example, weapon-smith and armorer as the always-roll proficiencies. The Proficiency Tables cross-references (Tables 56 and 58-61) close in their own rounds
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 104 closed, 131 open - the Non-Weapon Proficiencies box flips (census 574 -> 575); NEXT - R653: Table 56 (Character Proficiencies), capture p. 99, prefix dhn (verify free), audit "R653 OA character proficiencies audit", include after rules/oanwprof.h

consts.name: dhmCategoryCount
consts.comment: the four peaceful-skill categories - Common, Artisan, Court and Barbarian (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmImproveFromLevel
consts.comment: the slot improvement opens at second level or beyond (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmSlotBonusPerSlot
consts.comment: each additional slot spent adds +1 to the die roll - the print pass prints the plus, the compressed renders it as a minus (the R650 artifact class; capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmSuccessFloor
consts.comment: the chance of success after all modifiers never less than 3 on 1d20 (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmAkimoriCalligSlots
consts.comment: the Akimori example - two slots to gain calligraphy at first level (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmAkimoriCalligBase
consts.comment: the calligraphy base chance of success 17 (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmAkimoriChanceAtThird
consts.comment: the chance at third level 16 - one additional slot, +1 on the die roll (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmAkimoriChanceAtFourth
consts.comment: the chance at fourth level 14 - two more slots, +3 on the die roll (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmOptExampleBonus
consts.comment: the optional bonus for providing an example of the skill - +1 (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmOptPerformBonus
consts.comment: the optional bonus for actually performing the skill - +2 (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmInformalContestXPBase
consts.comment: the informal contest win - experience 50 times the host's level (capture p. 103 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

consts.name: dhmFormalContestXPBase
consts.comment: the formal contest win - experience 100 times the host's level (capture p. 103 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmOnlyBarbariansLearnBarbarian
bools.comment: only barbarian characters can learn barbarian proficiencies (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmCategoriesSetLearningEnvironment
bools.comment: the categories set the learning environment and assist the DM with NPC proficiencies - the peasant the Common list, the noble the Court list (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmNoRequiredStudyTimes
bools.comment: no required times of study for the peaceful proficiencies (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmLearningNeedsToolsAndGuidance
bools.comment: learning needs the tools at hand plus an environment with training and guidance from those skilled in the art (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmContactAmountUndecided
bools.comment: the amount of contact with the masters purposely left undecided (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmBaseLikeToHitRoll
bools.comment: the base number is identical to the to-hit roll - this number or greater on 1d20 succeeds (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmBaseNeverImprovesWithLevel
bools.comment: the base number never improves with level, unlike weapon proficiencies (capture p. 101 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmNoLimitOnSlotsSpent
bools.comment: no limit to the slots spent on a single peaceful proficiency (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmMagicOnlyIfKnown
bools.comment: magical proficiency items only help if the proficiency is already known (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmOptPlayerNotCharacter
bools.comment: the optional bonuses rest on the actions of the player, not the character (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmOptStrictlyOptional
bools.comment: the peaceful proficiency bonus rule is strictly optional (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmMostNoClearCutCheck
bools.comment: most peaceful proficiencies have no clear-cut success or failure - no die roll required in normal cases (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmQualityRollAtBaseSuperior
bools.comment: the quality roll - at or above the base chance is superior work, below is average or worse (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmSomeAlwaysRoll
bools.comment: some proficiencies - weapon-smith, armorer - always roll, noted on the Proficiency Tables (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmContestsRegularFeature
bools.comment: contests in the peaceful arts are a regular feature of life in the OA world (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmVictorsGainHonorAndXP
bools.comment: the victors gain honor and experience, the defeated lose honor - the outcome moves the social position (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmFormalAnnouncedInAdvance
bools.comment: formal contests at court or noble households are announced in advance, with a chosen subject or improvisation (capture p. 102 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmNonattendanceLosesHonor
bools.comment: non-attendance at a formal contest costs a small loss of honor unless circumstances prevent it (capture p. 103 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmImpromptuSmallerStakes
bools.comment: impromptu contests carry smaller honor gains and losses than formal affairs (capture p. 103 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmFailureEliminatesContestant
bools.comment: the contest resolution - a failed die roll eliminates the contestant, repeats until one remains the winner (capture p. 103 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)

bools.name: dhmAllFailFirstIsInauspicious
bools.comment: if all entrants fail the first die roll the contest is inauspicious - no winner, no honor changes (capture p. 103 of the print pass; compressed p. 53)
